cn_steps: 用 `-trace=cpu,frame,chaoslocks` 启动编辑器或打包游戏（也可在会话中执行 `Trace.Start cpu,frame,chaoslocks`）。`ChaosLocks` 通道记录 Chaos 求解器读写锁的 begin / acquired / end 周期时间戳。
复现卡顿：让关卡里出现大量刚体碰撞、Geometry Collection 破碎或求解器迭代尖峰，使物理线程与游戏线程争锁。
打开 `UnrealInsights.exe`，加载这次生成的 `.utrace`。分析器模块 `ChaosInsightsAnalysis` 会解析锁事件；`ChaosInsightsUI` 在 Insights 里画出 Chaos 锁时间线。
对照 Timing Insights 的 Physics / Chaos 计时器，找出长时间持锁或反复失败获取的区间，再回头减碰撞对数、求解器迭代或错开 GT 对物理场景的写入。
不要把 `ChaosInsightsUI` 写进游戏 `Build.cs`；Shipping 包只在需要时带 Analysis 依赖，平时用命令行 Trace，不要为洞察功能加运行时 Actor。
en_steps: Launch the editor or a cooked build with `-trace=cpu,frame,chaoslocks` (or `Trace.Start cpu,frame,chaoslocks` mid-session). The `ChaosLocks` channel records Chaos solver read/write lock begin / acquired / end cycle timestamps.
Reproduce the hitch: heavy rigid contacts, Geometry Collection breaks, or solver-iteration spikes so the physics thread contends with the game thread.
Open `UnrealInsights.exe` and load the `.utrace`. `ChaosInsightsAnalysis` parses lock events; `ChaosInsightsUI` draws the Chaos lock timeline inside Insights.
Align those spans with Physics / Chaos timers in Timing Insights, then cut contact pairs, solver iterations, or game-thread writes into the physics scene.
Do not add `ChaosInsightsUI` to a game `Build.cs`. Ship Analysis only if you must; drive capture from the command line, not a runtime Actor.
note_cn: 这是 Unreal Insights 的 Chaos 锁分析扩展，不是关卡组件。关注 `ChaosLocks` 通道，不要和 Chaos Visual Debugger 的 `.utrace` 物理录像混用。
note_en: Unreal Insights extension for Chaos lock contention, not a level component. Use the `ChaosLocks` channel; do not confuse it with Chaos Visual Debugger physics recordings.

cn_steps: 先启用 `Chaos Modular Vehicle`，再启用内容插件 `Chaos Modular Vehicle Examples`（无运行时模块，只带示例资产）并重启。
在内容浏览器打开插件内容（Show Plugin Content），进入 `ChaosModularVehicleExamples` 目录，打开自带示例关卡而非空地图。

选中示例 `ModularVehicleClusterPawn` 蓝图，对照组件树：根上是 Cluster Union 车辆组件，子级是车身/车轮 `Geometry Collection`，再挂 `VehicleSimEngine` / `VehicleSimClutch` / `VehicleSimTransmission` / `VehicleSimSuspension` / `VehicleSimWheel`。
Play 后用项目默认输入开车；故意撞碎可分离零件，确认碎块不再跟着底盘走（示例已开 `Force Update Active Transforms`）。
把需要的 Geometry Collection 零件和蓝图 Duplicate 到项目内容，再改网格与质量；不要直接改引擎插件目录里的示例包。
这不是 Chaos Vehicles（骨骼网格载具）示例；两边插件不要当成同一套资产。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Modular Vehicle` first, then the content plugin `Chaos Modular Vehicle Examples` (no runtime modules, sample assets only) and restart.
Turn on Show Plugin Content, browse `ChaosModularVehicleExamples`, and open the shipped sample map instead of an empty level.

Inspect a sample `ModularVehicleClusterPawn`: Cluster Union vehicle component at the root, chassis/wheel `Geometry Collection` children, then `VehicleSimEngine` / `VehicleSimClutch` / `VehicleSimTransmission` / `VehicleSimSuspension` / `VehicleSimWheel`.
PIE with default project input. Break off detachable parts and confirm debris does not hitch a ride on the chassis (`Force Update Active Transforms` is on in the samples).
Duplicate needed Geometry Collections and Blueprints into project content before changing meshes or masses; do not edit the engine plugin packages in place.
These are not Chaos Vehicles (skeletal-mesh) samples; do not mix the two plugins’ assets.
note_cn: 纯示例内容包，描述符不列出运行时模块。真正开车靠 `Chaos Modular Vehicle`；本插件只提供可拆的 Geometry Collection 载具样例。
note_en: Content-only pack with no runtime modules. Driving comes from `Chaos Modular Vehicle`; this plugin only ships breakable Geometry Collection vehicle samples.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用实验性 `Chaos Modular Vehicle`（`ChaosModularVehicle`、`ChaosModularVehicleEngine`）并重启；它与 `Chaos Vehicles` 骨骼网格载具是两套系统，不必同时开。
用 Fracture 把车身、轮毂等静态网格生成 `Geometry Collection`；每个零件一块 GC，不要合成一张骨骼网格。
新建蓝图，父类选 `ModularVehicleClusterPawn`。根上已有 Cluster Union 车辆组件和 Network Physics 组件。
把各 GC 拖进组件树、挂到 Cluster Union 下，按 X 前 Y 右 Z 上对齐。每个当车轮的 GC 下加 `VehicleSimSuspension`，其下再加 `VehicleSimWheel`；底盘 GC 下按扭矩流向串 `VehicleSimEngine` → `VehicleSimClutch` → `VehicleSimTransmission`。
在 Clustering 里勾选 `Force Update Active Transforms`，否则掉落零件静止后会跟着 Actor 平移。配置输入到车辆模拟组件，必要时加 `VehicleSimThruster` / `VehicleSimAerofoil`。
联网时走 Chaos 网络物理重模拟，不要用 CMC/旧载具的 Network Prediction。运行时用 Cluster Union 的 `AddComponentToCluster` 动态加零件。
`ChaosModularVehicleEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`；游戏模块只依赖 `ChaosModularVehicle` / `ChaosModularVehicleEngine`。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Chaos Modular Vehicle` (`ChaosModularVehicle`, `ChaosModularVehicleEngine`) and restart. It is separate from skeletal-mesh `Chaos Vehicles`; you do not need both.
Fracture chassis, wheels, and other static meshes into per-part `Geometry Collection` assets — do not build one skeletal mesh.
Create a Blueprint parented to `ModularVehicleClusterPawn`. The Cluster Union vehicle component and Network Physics component are already on the root.

Drop each GC under the Cluster Union (X forward, Y right, Z up). Under each wheel GC add `VehicleSimSuspension` then `VehicleSimWheel`. Under the chassis GC chain torque as `VehicleSimEngine` → `VehicleSimClutch` → `VehicleSimTransmission`.

Enable `Force Update Active Transforms` under Clustering so sleeping debris does not follow the pawn. Wire input into the vehicle simulation component; add `VehicleSimThruster` / `VehicleSimAerofoil` if needed.
Replicate with Chaos networked physics resimulation, not CMC/legacy-vehicle Network Prediction. At runtime, attach extra parts with Cluster Union `AddComponentToCluster`.
Put `ChaosModularVehicleEditor` only in `*Editor.Build.cs`; game modules depend on `ChaosModularVehicle` / `ChaosModularVehicleEngine`.
note_cn: 载具是 Cluster Union + 多块 Geometry Collection，不是 Physics Asset 骨骼车。仿真组件的父子关系就是扭矩/悬架力的流向。
note_en: The vehicle is a Cluster Union of Geometry Collections, not a Physics Asset skeletal car. Simulation-component parenting is the torque and suspension force graph.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `Mover` 与实验性 `Chaos Mover`（模块 `ChaosMover`）并重启。这是在物理线程上跑的 Mover 后端，不能把普通 `UWalkingMode` 原样丢进去。
在 `Project Settings > Physics` 打开 `Tick Physics Async`；联机再开 `Enable Physics Prediction`。Chaos Mover 强制异步固定步长，关异步物理无法正确步进。
Pawn 上用 `UChaosCharacterMoverComponent`（不要用 CMC）。地面模式需要角色地面约束；模式列表放 `UChaosWalkingMode`、`UChaosFallingMode`，需要时再加 `UChaosSwimmingMode` / `UChaosFlyingMode` 或带弹簧平滑的 `UChaosSmoothWalkingMode`。
自定义模式必须只碰已封送的 `FMoverTickStartData` / `FProposedMove`，禁止在 PT 回调里碰 `UObject` 或游戏线程状态。输入经 `UChaosMoverBackendComponent` 封送到物理线程。
场景里可互动物体也要做物理复制，否则客户端重模拟会和角色脱步。Chaos Mover 角色不能与走 Network Prediction 的普通 Mover Actor 对齐。
游戏 `Build.cs` 加 `ChaosMover`（通常还要 `Mover`）；参考 Mover Examples 里的 `PhysicsMannyPawn` / `L_PhysicsSimulatedCharacter`，不要抄 CMC 角色。
en_steps: Enable both `Mover` and experimental `Chaos Mover` (module `ChaosMover`) and restart. This is the physics-thread Mover backend; stock `UWalkingMode` is not drop-in.
Turn on `Tick Physics Async` under `Project Settings > Physics`; for net play also enable `Enable Physics Prediction`. Chaos Mover requires an async fixed timestep.

Put `UChaosCharacterMoverComponent` on the pawn (not CMC). Ground motion needs a character ground constraint. Register `UChaosWalkingMode` and `UChaosFallingMode`, plus `UChaosSwimmingMode` / `UChaosFlyingMode` or spring-smoothed `UChaosSmoothWalkingMode` as needed.
Custom modes may touch only marshalled `FMoverTickStartData` / `FProposedMove` — no `UObject` or game-thread state on the physics thread. Inputs go through `UChaosMoverBackendComponent`.
Replicate other interactive physics actors or clients will desync on resim. Chaos Mover pawns are not synced with Network Prediction Mover actors.
Add `ChaosMover` (and usually `Mover`) to game `Build.cs`. Start from Mover Examples `PhysicsMannyPawn` / `L_PhysicsSimulatedCharacter`, not a CMC character.
note_cn: 和 CMC / 标准 Mover 不兼容：模拟在物理线程。输入到动作会有插值延迟；Experimental，接口会变。
note_en: Incompatible with CMC and stock Mover modes: simulation runs on the physics thread. Expect input-to-motion interpolation delay. Experimental APIs.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Niagara`（模块 `ChaosNiagara`）并重启；同时保证 Niagara 与 Geometry Collection 破坏流程可用。
在 `Project Settings` 搜索 `Generate Data`，打开 Collision / Breaking / Trailing 数据生成，否则求解器不会把事件送给 Niagara。
选中关卡里的 `Geometry Collection`，在 ChaosPhysics > Events 按特效需要勾选 `Notify Collisions`、`Notify Breaks` 或 `Notify Trailing`（拖尾还常要 `Store Velocities`）。
新建 Niagara System。在 Niagara 参数里加 Chaos Destruction 数据接口，Data Type 只能三选一：`Collision`、`Breaking` 或 `Trailing`。同一 System 不能同时吃两类事件，要第二类就复制一份 System。
Emitter Update 用 `Spawn from Chaos`，Particle Spawn 用 `Apply Chaos Data`，按尺寸/速度/物理材质过滤，避免每步把整场破碎灌进粒子。
把 Niagara 放到同一 Chaos Solver 作用范围（世界求解器或 `AChaosSolverActor`）。Breaking 做出碎瞬间的尘土爆炸，Collision 做落地火花，Trailing 做飞片烟迹。
游戏模块按需依赖 `ChaosNiagara`；Shipping 里关掉不需要的 Notify，否则事件列表会打满。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Niagara` (module `ChaosNiagara`) and restart; keep Niagara and Geometry Collection destruction available.
In `Project Settings` search `Generate Data` and enable Collision / Breaking / Trailing generation, or the solver never feeds Niagara.
On each `Geometry Collection`, under ChaosPhysics > Events, enable `Notify Collisions`, `Notify Breaks`, and/or `Notify Trailing` (Trailing often also needs `Store Velocities`).
Create a Niagara System and add the Chaos Destruction data interface. Data Type is exactly one of `Collision`, `Breaking`, or `Trailing`. Duplicate the System if you need a second event class.
Use `Spawn from Chaos` in Emitter Update and `Apply Chaos Data` in Particle Spawn. Filter by size, speed, and physical material so every solver tick does not flood the emitter.
Place the system in the same Chaos Solver domain (world solver or `AChaosSolverActor`). Breaking → burst on fracture, Collision → impact dust/sparks, Trailing → debris smoke.
Depend on `ChaosNiagara` in game modules only if you talk to it in C++. Disable unused Notify flags in Shipping or event lists explode.
note_cn: 二次特效插件：读 Chaos 碰撞/破碎/拖尾，不求解物理。一个 Niagara System 只绑定一种 Chaos 事件类型。
note_en: Secondary VFX only: it consumes Chaos collision/break/trailing data, it does not solve physics. One Niagara System binds one Chaos event type.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Outfit Asset`（`ChaosOutfitAssetEngine`、`ChaosOutfitAssetDataflowNodes`、`ChaosOutfitAssetEditor`）并确保 `Chaos Cloth Asset` 已开，然后重启。
内容浏览器右键 `Physics / Cloth` 新建 `Chaos Outfit Asset`（`UChaosOutfitAsset`）。组装基础套装时选 Resizable Outfit 模板，不要用会剥掉仿真网格的 MetaHuman Creator 导出图。
打开资产上的 Dataflow：把已有 `Chaos Cloth Asset` 零件（上衣、裤、裙）接进图，指定绑定用的骨架网格，求值生成组合后的渲染/仿真网格与材质槽。
角色蓝图上加 Chaos Cloth 组件，把 Outfit 赋给组件（槽位类型是 `ChaosClothAssetBase`，Cloth 与 Outfit 都能塞）。Play 看布料，不要只看静态预览。
要适配另一种身材：再新建 Outfit，选 Resizing Graph 模板，Details 里 `Resizable Outfit` 指基础套装，`Target Body` 指目标骨架，`Strip Sim Mesh` 设为 false，Generate 后再赋给该角色。
缩放只能在编辑器求值/Cook，不能运行时 Resize。`ChaosOutfitAssetEditor` 只进 Editor 模块；运行时依赖 `ChaosOutfitAssetEngine`。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Outfit Asset` (`ChaosOutfitAssetEngine`, `ChaosOutfitAssetDataflowNodes`, `ChaosOutfitAssetEditor`) with `Chaos Cloth Asset` already on, then restart.
Content Browser: `Physics / Cloth` → `Chaos Outfit Asset` (`UChaosOutfitAsset`). For a sim-ready wardrobe use the Resizable Outfit template, not a MetaHuman Creator graph that strips the sim mesh.
Open the asset Dataflow, wire existing `Chaos Cloth Asset` pieces (shirt, pants, skirt), set the bind skeletal mesh, and evaluate to build combined render/sim meshes and material slots.
On the character, add a Chaos Cloth component and assign the Outfit (`ChaosClothAssetBase` accepts Cloth or Outfit). PIE the cloth; a static thumbnail is not a sim.

For another body: create a second Outfit with the Resizing Graph template, set `Resizable Outfit` to the base outfit, `Target Body` to the target skeleton, `Strip Sim Mesh` = false, Generate, then assign that asset.
Resize is editor evaluate/cook only — not runtime. `ChaosOutfitAssetEditor` is editor-only; runtime depends on `ChaosOutfitAssetEngine`.
note_cn: Outfit 是多件 Cloth Asset 的 Dataflow 组装/缩放容器，不是独立求解器。保留仿真必须 `Strip Sim Mesh = false`。
note_en: An Outfit is a Dataflow assembly/resize of Cloth Assets, not its own solver. Keep simulation with `Strip Sim Mesh = false`.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Chaos Rigid Asset`（`ChaosRigidAssetEngine`、`ChaosRigidAssetNodes`、`ChaosRigidAssetEditor`）并重启。它制作刚体集合，不是 Geometry Collection 破碎图。
内容浏览器新建 `Chaos Rigid Asset`，打开绑定的 Dataflow。用 `ChaosRigidAssetNodes` 把静态网格/碰撞体导入为刚体粒子，设置质量、惯性、碰撞形状与约束。
求值 Dataflow，在资产视口里检查刚体集合是否按约束连接。需要预览步进时打开能跑 Chaos 的 Dataflow 求解（见 `ChaosDataflowSolver`）。
把生成的刚体集合放到关卡 Actor/组件上，或作为 Outfit/布料管线的碰撞刚体输入，而不是拖进 Fracture 模式再切一次。
运行时模块用 `ChaosRigidAssetEngine`；图节点用 `ChaosRigidAssetNodes`。`ChaosRigidAssetEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。
Experimental：资产格式与节点名会变。不要用它替代 Fracture 的可破碎 Geometry Collection。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Chaos Rigid Asset` (`ChaosRigidAssetEngine`, `ChaosRigidAssetNodes`, `ChaosRigidAssetEditor`) and restart. It authors rigid-body collections, not Geometry Collection fracture graphs.
Create a `Chaos Rigid Asset` and open its Dataflow. Use `ChaosRigidAssetNodes` to ingest static meshes/colliders as rigid particles and set mass, inertia, collision shapes, and constraints.
Evaluate the graph and inspect the collection in the asset viewport. For stepped preview, enable a Dataflow Chaos solver (`ChaosDataflowSolver`).
Place the collection on a level actor/component, or feed it as rigid colliders into Outfit/cloth pipelines — do not send it through Fracture Mode.
Runtime: `ChaosRigidAssetEngine`. Graph nodes: `ChaosRigidAssetNodes`. `ChaosRigidAssetEditor` belongs only in `*Editor.Build.cs`.
Experimental: asset format and node names can change. This does not replace fracture Geometry Collections.
note_cn: Dataflow 刚体集合资产，面向成组刚体与约束，不是破坏切片工具。
note_en: Dataflow rigid-body collection asset for grouped bodies and constraints, not a fracture/slice tool.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Chaos Rigid Physics Async`（模块 `ChaosRigidPhysicsAsync`）并重启。它提供 Chaos 刚体引擎的异步实现，不是新的关卡 Actor 类型。
在 `Project Settings > Physics` 打开 `Tick Physics Async`（固定物理步长）。联机再开 Physics Prediction，让 GT 插值追物理线程。
用普通 Chaos 刚体、Geometry Collection 或 Chaos Mover 角色做场景；异步后端在独立物理线程推进刚体，不需要换组件类。
用 `stat chaos` / Unreal Insights 看物理线程与游戏线程是否脱步。交互物必须复制物理状态，否则预测回滚会抖。
游戏 `Build.cs` 仅在直接调用该后端 API 时加 `ChaosRigidPhysicsAsync`；多数项目启用插件即可，求解器由引擎物理模块拉起。
不要和同步求解混在同一套「必须同帧读写刚体变换」的玩法里；异步有一到数帧延迟。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Chaos Rigid Physics Async` (module `ChaosRigidPhysicsAsync`) and restart. It is the async Chaos rigid-body engine, not a new actor type.
Enable `Tick Physics Async` under `Project Settings > Physics` (fixed physics dt). For net play also enable Physics Prediction so the game thread interpolates toward the physics thread.
Author the scene with normal Chaos rigid bodies, Geometry Collections, or Chaos Mover characters. The backend steps bodies on the physics thread; you do not swap component classes.
Watch `stat chaos` / Unreal Insights for GT vs PT drift. Replicate interactive physics or prediction rollbacks will hitch.
Add `ChaosRigidPhysicsAsync` to game `Build.cs` only if you call its API. Most projects just enable the plugin and let the engine physics module load it.
Do not mix it with gameplay that must read/write rigid transforms on the same game frame; async implies one or more frames of delay.
note_cn: 异步刚体求解后端，无编辑器面板工作流。给 Chaos Mover、网络预测刚体提供 PT 固定步长。
note_en: Async rigid solver backend with no editor-panel workflow. Supplies the PT fixed timestep used by Chaos Mover and predicted rigid bodies.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Chaos Solver`（编辑器模块 `ChaosSolverEditor`，运行时求解 Actor 在引擎 `ChaosSolverEngine`）并重启。
在关卡里放置 `AChaosSolverActor`（Place Actors 搜 Chaos Solver）。默认世界只有一个隐式求解器；独立 Actor 用来隔离一堆破坏物体。
选中 `Geometry Collection` 组件，把 Chaos Solver Actor / Override Solver 指到该 Actor。未指定则走世界默认求解器。
在 Solver Actor 上调时间步、碰撞/推开迭代、休眠阈值，使这一组破碎与角色控制器、载具不抢同一个求解预算。
需要二次特效时，把 Niagara Chaos DI 也指到同一 Solver，否则 Breaking 事件对不上这组物体。
不要把 `ChaosSolverEditor` 加进 Game Target。运行时生成求解器用 `ChaosSolverEngine` 的 `AChaosSolverActor`，蓝图可 `SetSolverActor`。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Chaos Solver` (editor module `ChaosSolverEditor`; the runtime actor lives in engine `ChaosSolverEngine`) and restart.
Place an `AChaosSolverActor` (Place Actors → Chaos Solver). The world already has an implicit solver; a dedicated actor isolates a destruction set.
On each `Geometry Collection` component, set Chaos Solver Actor / Override Solver to that actor. Unset components use the world solver.
Tune the actor’s time step, collision/push-out iterations, and sleep thresholds so this break pile does not share solver budget with characters or vehicles.
Point Niagara Chaos DIs at the same solver if you want secondary FX, or Breaking events will not match this group.
Never link `ChaosSolverEditor` into a Game Target. Spawn `AChaosSolverActor` via `ChaosSolverEngine` and call `SetSolverActor` from Blueprint if needed.
note_cn: 插件主体是求解器 Actor 的编辑器支持。隔离破坏模拟用 `AChaosSolverActor`，不是再画一遍世界物理。
note_en: Editor support for physics-solver actors. Isolate destruction with `AChaosSolverActor`; it does not replace world physics.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Visual Debugger`（`ChaosVD`、`ChaosVDBlueprint`、`ChaosVDBuiltInExtensions`）并重启。从编辑器菜单打开 CVD，或运行独立程序 `ChaosVisualDebugger`。
在 CVD 的 Data Channels 里勾选要录的通道（如 `SceneQueries`、`PostIntegrate`）。命令行等价：`p.Chaos.VD.SetCVDDataChannelEnabled true SceneQueries,PostIntegrate`。
Play 后在 CVD 工具栏对 Local Editor 点 Record to File，结束时 Stop。会写出 `.utrace`（不是旧的 `.cvd`）。也可在目标进程执行 `p.Chaos.StartVDRecording` / `p.Chaos.StopVDRecording`。
加载录像后逐帧看刚体变换、约束、碰撞与场景查询；联网可一次加载多路客户端/服务器录像做对比。
打包游戏用 `CVDDataChannelsOverride=SceneQueries,PostIntegrate` 预开通道。蓝图侧用 `ChaosVDBlueprint` 启停录制。
CVD 是调试录像，不要打进 Shipping 玩法。录制开销大，只开需要的通道。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Visual Debugger` (`ChaosVD`, `ChaosVDBlueprint`, `ChaosVDBuiltInExtensions`) and restart. Open CVD from the editor menu or run standalone `ChaosVisualDebugger`.
In CVD Data Channels, enable what you need (e.g. `SceneQueries`, `PostIntegrate`). CLI: `p.Chaos.VD.SetCVDDataChannelEnabled true SceneQueries,PostIntegrate`.
PIE, then Record to File on the Local Editor target in CVD and Stop. Output is `.utrace` (not legacy `.cvd`). Alternatively `p.Chaos.StartVDRecording` / `p.Chaos.StopVDRecording` on the target.
Load the recording and step rigid transforms, constraints, contacts, and scene queries. For net play, load several client/server captures at once.
For cooked builds, preload channels with `CVDDataChannelsOverride=SceneQueries,PostIntegrate`. Blueprint start/stop lives in `ChaosVDBlueprint`.
CVD is a debug recorder, not Shipping gameplay. Recording is expensive — enable only required channels.
note_cn: Chaos 物理可视化调试器，录的是物理状态 `.utrace`，不是 Insights 的 `ChaosLocks` 性能通道。
note_en: Visual debugger for Chaos physics state. It records physics `.utrace` files, not the Insights `ChaosLocks` performance channel.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `ChaosCaching`（`ChaosCaching`、`ChaosCachingEditor`）并重启。
关卡放置 `AChaosCacheManager`。在 Details 新建 `Chaos Cache Collection` 资产，作为录像容器。
在 `Observed Components` 里添加要录的 `Geometry Collection`（或支持缓存的刚体组件），每条必须填 `Cache Name`，否则不会写入 Collection。
`Cache Mode` 设为 `Record`，`Start Mode` 用 Timed（BeginPlay 计时）或 Triggered（调用 `TriggerObservedComponent`）。Simulate/PIE 把破碎跑完后停止。
把 Mode 改成 `Play`。Manager 会按缓存驱动观察对象，不再实时求解。拖进 Sequencer，加 Chaos Cache 轨道或关键帧 `Start Time`，即可倒带、变速、对齐镜头。
运行时依赖 `ChaosCaching`；编辑器定制在 `ChaosCachingEditor`。缓存是确定回放，改了 GC 拓扑要重录。
en_steps: Enable experimental `ChaosCaching` (`ChaosCaching`, `ChaosCachingEditor`) and restart.
Place `AChaosCacheManager`. In Details, create a `Chaos Cache Collection` asset as the recording container.
Add each `Geometry Collection` (or cacheable rigid component) under `Observed Components` and set a `Cache Name` per entry or nothing is stored.
Set `Cache Mode` to `Record`. `Start Mode` Timed counts from BeginPlay; Triggered waits for `TriggerObservedComponent`. Simulate/PIE the break, then stop.

Switch Mode to `Play` so the manager drives observers from the cache instead of live solving. Add the manager to Sequencer (Chaos Cache track or keyed `Start Time`) to scrub, retimed, and sync to cameras.
Runtime module is `ChaosCaching`; editor UI is `ChaosCachingEditor`. Playback is deterministic — re-record after GC topology changes.
note_cn: 把 Chaos 模拟烤成可 Sequencer 倒带的 Cache Collection。`Cache Name` 为空等于没录。
note_en: Bakes a Chaos sim into a Sequencer-scrubbable Cache Collection. An empty `Cache Name` means nothing is recorded.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `ChaosClothAsset Toolset`（模块 `ChaosClothAssetToolset`）并重启。它是给编辑器 AI 代理调用的工具，不是运行时布料求解器。
同时打开 `Chaos Cloth Asset`（以及要用套装时的 `Chaos Outfit Asset`），否则代理创建的资产无法求值。
在编辑器 AI / Agent 会话里让它「用指定骨架网格创建 ChaosClothAsset 并分配到角色」。工具集会走创建 Cloth 资产、绑骨骼、赋 Chaos Cloth 组件的流程。
生成后打开 Cloth 资产的 Dataflow 检查仿真网格、权重图和碰撞体，再 PIE 角色；不要把工具集输出直接当 Shipping 服装。
不要把 `ChaosClothAssetToolset` 写进游戏 `Build.cs` 或 Shipping 插件列表；只留在编辑器 Toolsets 目录。
en_steps: Enable experimental `ChaosClothAsset Toolset` (module `ChaosClothAssetToolset`) and restart. It is an editor AI-agent toolbox, not a runtime cloth solver.
Also enable `Chaos Cloth Asset` (and `Chaos Outfit Asset` if assembling outfits) or assets the agent creates cannot evaluate.

In an editor AI / Agent session, ask it to create a `ChaosClothAsset` for a given skeletal mesh and assign it on the character. The toolset runs create / bind / assign through a Chaos Cloth component.
Open the new Cloth asset Dataflow and verify sim mesh, weight maps, and colliders, then PIE the character. Do not treat toolset output as Shipping wardrobe.
Do not add `ChaosClothAssetToolset` to game `Build.cs` or Shipping plugin lists; it stays under editor Toolsets.
note_cn: 编辑器 AI 工具集：创建并分配 ChaosClothAsset。不含求解器，不要当布料运行时插件。
note_en: Editor AI toolset for creating and assigning ChaosClothAsset. No solver; not a runtime cloth plugin.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `ChaosDataflowSolver`（模块 `ChaosDataflowSolver`）并重启。它在 Dataflow 图求值时步进 Chaos，不是关卡里的 `AChaosSolverActor`。
打开 Cloth Asset、Outfit、Rigid Asset 或带物理预览节点的 Geometry Collection Dataflow。
图中加入/启用 Chaos Dataflow Solver 节点，设置子步与迭代，接到刚体/布料粒子输出上。
在 Dataflow 编辑器里求值或播放预览：求解器在编辑器里推进粒子，用来调约束和碰撞，不必每次 PIE。
预览稳定后再把资产赋给角色或关卡组件，运行时仍走世界/`AChaosSolverActor`，不会在 Shipping 里每帧跑这张 Dataflow。
游戏 `Build.cs` 不要依赖 `ChaosDataflowSolver`，除非你在自定义编辑器/离线烘焙里求值同一张图。
en_steps: Enable experimental `ChaosDataflowSolver` (module `ChaosDataflowSolver`) and restart. It steps Chaos during Dataflow evaluation, and is not level `AChaosSolverActor`.
Open a Cloth, Outfit, Rigid Asset, or Geometry Collection Dataflow that has physics-preview nodes.
Add/enable the Chaos Dataflow Solver node, set substeps/iterations, and wire it to rigid/cloth particle outputs.
Evaluate or play preview in the Dataflow editor so the solver advances particles while you tune constraints and contacts — no PIE required.
Once the preview is stable, assign the asset to a character or level component. Runtime still uses the world solver / `AChaosSolverActor`; Shipping does not tick this graph every frame.
Do not depend on `ChaosDataflowSolver` in game `Build.cs` unless you evaluate the same graph in a custom editor/offline bake.
note_cn: Dataflow 内的 Chaos 预览求解器，服务 Cloth/Rigid 资产作者。官方 .uplugin 无描述，不要当成关卡物理求解器。
note_en: In-graph Chaos preview solver for Cloth/Rigid authors. The .uplugin has no description; it is not the level physics solver.

cn_steps: 启用 `ChaosEditor`（模块 `FractureEditor`，菜单名常为 Fracture）并重启。这是 Geometry Collection 的破坏编辑器，不是运行时求解器。
选中静态网格 Actor，切到工具栏 `Fracture` 模式，用 Generate / New 创建 `Geometry Collection` 资产并替换关卡里的网格。
用 Uniform Voronoi、Cluster、Radial、Plane、Slice、Brick 或 Mesh 等切片工具切块；调噪声与随机种子。
再用 Clustering 把小块合成层级、Embed 把内部网格嵌进去、AutoUV 和材质槽整理断面。保存 GC 资产。
回到选择模式，在 GC 上设 Damage Threshold、碰撞与 `Notify Breaks` 等，PIE 用力场或碰撞打坏。切片本身不模拟。
`FractureEditor` 只进 Editor Target。运行时破碎由 Geometry Collection 组件 + Chaos 求解器执行。
en_steps: Enable `ChaosEditor` (module `FractureEditor`, usually the Fracture mode) and restart. This is the Geometry Collection destruction editor, not the runtime solver.
Select a static mesh actor, switch the toolbar to `Fracture` mode, and Generate / New a `Geometry Collection` asset that replaces the mesh in the level.
Slice with Uniform Voronoi, Cluster, Radial, Plane, Slice, Brick, or Mesh tools; tune noise and seed.
Use Clustering to build a break hierarchy, Embed for interior meshes, AutoUV and material slots for faces. Save the GC asset.
Leave Fracture mode, set Damage Threshold, collision, and `Notify Breaks` on the GC, then PIE with a field or impact. Slicing does not simulate.
`FractureEditor` is editor-target only. Runtime breaking is the Geometry Collection component plus the Chaos solver.
note_cn: 官方描述是 Destruction Tools：Fracture 模式作者工具。不要把 `FractureEditor` 链进游戏。
note_en: Ships as Destruction Tools: the Fracture-mode authoring UI. Do not link `FractureEditor` into the game.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `ChaosUserDataPT`（模块 `ChaosUserDataPT`）并重启。它提供「游戏线程只写、物理线程只读」的每粒子自定义数据，没有窗口面板。
游戏 `Build.cs` 加入 `ChaosUserDataPT`，`#include` 插件 Public 头，在 GT 上按粒子句柄写入伤害类型、队伍、忽略碰撞掩码等用户数据。
在物理线程回调（碰撞修饰、接触过滤、求解器中间件）里只读这份数据，不要在 PT 回写，也不要在 GT 读同一槽做同步假设。
粒子被销毁或 GC 簇释放时清掉对应 userdata，避免句柄复用读到脏标签。
用引擎 `ChaosUserDataPTTests` 程序验证封送；联机时 userdata 不会自动复制，复制的是你在 GT 写入前的玩法状态。
不要用它在物理线程碰 `UObject`。它只是粒子侧 POD/句柄载荷，用来避免 GT/PT 竞态。
en_steps: Enable experimental `ChaosUserDataPT` (module `ChaosUserDataPT`) and restart. It is per-particle userdata that is write-only on the game thread and read-only on the physics thread — no editor panel.
Add `ChaosUserDataPT` to game `Build.cs`, include the plugin Public headers, and from the GT write damage type, team, ignore masks, etc. keyed by particle handle.
In PT callbacks (collision modifiers, contact filters, solver middleware) only read that payload. Do not write it on the PT, and do not treat a GT read of the same slot as synchronized.
Clear userdata when particles die or GC clusters release, or handle reuse will see stale tags.
Use the engine `ChaosUserDataPTTests` program to verify marshalling. Userdata is not replicated; replicate the gameplay state you write from on the GT.
Do not touch `UObject`s on the physics thread. This is POD/handle payload on particles to avoid GT/PT races.
note_cn: C++ 粒子用户数据通道：GT 写、PT 读。不是编辑器工具，尽管分类写的是 Editor。
note_en: C++ per-particle userdata channel: GT write, PT read. Not an editor tool, despite the Editor category.
